title: Cosmetic 360 show to explore innovation ‘for positive impact'
summary: Cosmetic 360 is back at the Carrousel du Louvre, in Paris: 260 French and international exhibitors will attend the event next October 14-15, 2026. This year, the show is strengthening its showcasing positioning in cosmetics innovation with the common theme ‘Regenerations'. Held by Cosmetic Valley, the 12th edition of Cosmetic 360 is marked by the rising number of innovations introduced for the first time at a cosmetics show. “The show managed to find its own place on the global level.
